## 🇩🇪 German — Daily Phrases (3)
1. **Da bin ich ganz bei dir.** — [dah bin ish gahnts by deer] — *I completely agree with you.*
2. **Mir fällt gerade nichts ein.** — [meer felt geh-RAH-deh nikts ayn] — *Nothing comes to mind right now.*
3. **Es liegt mir am Herzen.** — [es leekt meer ahm HAIR-tsen] — *It's close to my heart / It matters to me.*
